Data-backed demos open on real staged data (rich-demos-k78j.3ok) (#381)

* feat(demos): data-backed demos open on real staged data (rich-demos-k78j.3ok)

claude-sessions: the owner's 21 real sessions from five projects, trimmed
and scrubbed by scripts/stage-claude-sessions.ts. rich-explore: 54 files of
this repository. rich-dash: a runner whose vitals never visibly repeat, this
repo's real pipeline steps, and its README. Each under examples/<demo>/staging/.

Also: parser joins an assistant message written one block per record (it
kept only the last, dropping text before a tool call); demo pages take their
card as escaped JSON, since VitePress writes params into a <script> and a
</script> in content broke the build; MAX_PROGRAM_BYTES 1 → 4 MiB so the
claude-sessions link fits.
